text:
maria: Starting intake for aurora-22b — short doc + quant experiments plan. Need prioritization and release window. pinging @jin @oliver for perf/ops.
jin: Thanks. Quick note: model is 22B dense, HuggingFace repo snapshot v1.0. Is training config compatible with our kernels? Need model artifact link.
maria: Link: https://huggingface.co/aurora/aurora-22b/tree/v1.0 (private). I'll add SHA and manifest in the intake doc.
oliver: Recommend initial quant targets: int8 fp16->8bit, and 4-bit q4_hybrid for latency mode. We'll run perf baseline on p4d and a40.
alex: For evaluation, can we run the open-source HELM subset + our internal convo prompt set? Need to measure token-level divergence vs reference.
priya: Add to catalog draft: short desc, training data provenance, license, safety flags, recommended tags (dense, causal, 22B, recommended: q4_hybrid).
catalog-bot: Catalog draft created: /models/redwood/aurora-22b/draft.md — please review. (automated)
jin: I'll queue perf jobs. Spawn commands below:
```
run_bench --model aurora-22b --devices p4d --quant fp16
run_bench --model aurora-22b --devices p4d --quant q4_hybrid --batch 1,4
```
Also capture memory traces.
oliver: Note: add KV cache warmup test for long-chat workloads (<=4k context). We saw cache thrash on similar 20b models.
alex: Quality regression plan: 1) run HELM subset 2) run internal evals (5k prompts) 3) human spot-check 50 examples flagged by metric drift.
maria: Operational rollout plan draft: canary on Dedicated, fallback to hosted tiny-variant (aurora-8b) on overload, rollout window Thu 00:00-04:00 PST. Thoughts?
jin: Canary + A/B ok. Add auto-fallback policy with 30s latency threshold. Also ensure model pin in config for customers.
oliver: Quant experiments: run q4 first; if quality drop >1.5% on HELM metric, try q3/quant-awareness or mixed-precision. Document prompt-prep (few-shot) effects.
priya: Release notes copy draft:
- Aurora 22B: high-quality causal model for chat & completion
- Default served as fp16; q4_hybrid recommended for latency-sensitive routes
- See catalog for benchmarks and safety flags
I'll post to #announcements after engineering review.
catalog-bot: Bench results: p4d fp16 median latency 120ms @batch1, q4_hybrid 70ms @batch1. Artifact: s3://rwd-models/aurora-22b/bench/1871234567/summary.json
jin: Observed token-level divergence: +0.8% for q4_hybrid vs fp16 on HELM subset. Diff heatmap attached (in thread).
alex: Suggest doc changes: add sample code snippet for streaming + function-calling. Also add migration notes for Dedicated customers.
maria: Team action items:
- Jin: full perf run + KV tests (eta 48h)
- Oliver: quant iterations + quality gating
- Priya: catalog + release notes
- Alex: docs + client snippets
I'll assemble announcement draft next week. :party-parrot:
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deployment window created: 2026-03-26 00:00 PST -> 2026-03-26 04:00 PST. ID: canary-aurora-1871234567
oliver: One more: add model eval seed reproducibility details to catalog (random seed, temperature configs).
